reason: As the maintainer I would rather own B: separate token-based CSS, a data-driven demo with play/pause/step controls, a native dialog with Escape and focus return, a skip link, reduced-motion handling in JS, and one BOOKING_URL constant that turns every CTA into the real link later; A's equivalent CTA is a dead self-anchor. A is stronger on touch targets, focus contrast and headline clarity, so if B's 'Most clinics pick...' line is confirmed as fabricated proof, or if the small demo targets are weighted heavily, I would switch to A.
